dedupe_keys.name: cargo unloaded by month and port

description: Cargo Unloaded, by Month and Port is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). This dataset contains Saudi Arabia Cargo Unloaded, by Month and port for 2008- 2018 (In Tons). Data from General Authority for Statistics. Export API data for more datasets to advance energy economics research. We have used year converter to find the Gregorian year. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are Cargo, ITEM, Cargo . The portal shows 2022-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
